mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ccds_duty_day (station_id, duty_date, main_officer_id, deputy_officer_id, note, group_snapshot_json) VALUES (#{stationId}, #{dutyDate}, #{mainOfficerId}, #{deputyOfficerId}, #{note}, #{groupSnapshotJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE ccds_duty_day SET station_id = #{stationId}, duty_date = #{dutyDate}, main_officer_id = #{mainOfficerId}, deputy_officer_id = #{deputyOfficerId}, note = #{note}, group_snapshot_json = #{groupSnapshotJson}, gmt_modified = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, station_id, duty_date, main_officer_id, deputy_officer_id, note, group_snapshot_json, gmt_create, gmt_modified FROM ccds_duty_day WHERE id = #{id}
